name: Tines MCP
description: Builds and edits Tines stories from Cursor, Claude Code, or ChatGPT through your tenant's MCP server, and publishes your own stories as custom MCP tools.

skills.name: Story Authoring
skills.description: Creates and modifies Tines stories from plain-language requests, such as adding an HTTP action that opens a Jira issue.

skills.name: Validate and Run Actions
skills.description: Reads current story contents, validates changes, and runs actions where your Tines permissions allow it.

skills.name: Custom MCP Servers
skills.description: Publishes your own Tines stories as remote MCP tools, protected by a secret, a Tines API key, or tenant membership.

skills.name: Audited Tool Use
skills.description: Records every MCP tool use in Tines audit logs as MCP activity so admins can review what a client changed.
